column1: # The tests that read a documentation path, one per row: package, target,
# and exact test name, separated by tabs. The target is lib, bin:<name>,
# test:<name>, or doc for the doctests of a crate whose crate docs include a
# documentation file; a doc row has - as its name.
# .github/scripts/run-docs-tests.py runs these rows in the docs-tests job of
# ci.yml. .github/scripts/check-docs-reads.py fails when a documentation read
# in the workspace sources has no row.
